ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $ \triangle ADE \sim \triangle ACB$. If $AD=6$, $DE=4$, and $BC=8$, then what is the length of AC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ACB$,\\
we have $\frac{AD}{AC}=\frac{DE}{CB}$,\\
thus $AC=\frac{AD \cdot CB}{DE}=\boxed{12}$.
